items.title: LongCat-Flash-Omni正式发布并开源：开启全模态实时交互时代
items.raw_excerpt: 11月3日， LongCat-Flash系列再升级，全新家族成员LongCat-Flash-Omni正式发布并开源，LongCat官方App同步上线公测。目前，新App已支持联网搜索、语音通话等功能，视频通话等功能会稍后上线；Web端则增加图片、文件上传和语音通话等功能。 据介绍，LongCat-Flash-Omni以LongCat-Flash系列的高效架构设计为基础（Shortcut-Connected MoE，含零计算专家），集成了高效多模态感知模块与语音重建模块，在总参数 5600 亿（激活参数 270 亿）的庞大参数规模下，仍实现低延迟的实时音视频交互能力，为开发者的多模态应用场景提供了更高效的技术选择。 新模型也是业界首个实现“全模态覆盖、端到端架构、大参数量高效推理”于一体的开源大语言模型，首次在开源范畴内实现了对标闭源模型的全模态能力，并凭借创新的架构设计与工程优化，让大参数模型在多模态任务中能实现毫秒级响应，解决行业内推理延迟的痛点。 具体来看，LongCat-Flash-Omni在一体化框架中整合了离线多模态理解与实时音视频交互能力，并采用完全端到端的设计，以视觉与音频编码器作为多模态感知器，由 LLM 直接处理输入并生成文本与语音token，再通过轻量级音频解码器重建为自然语音波形，从而实现低延迟的实时交互。所有模块均基于高效流式推理设计，视觉编码器、音频编解码器均为轻量级组件，参数量均约为6亿，延续了 LongCat-Flash 系列的创新型高效架构设计，实现了性能与推理效率间的最优平衡。 ▲LongCat-Flash-Omni模型架构 与此同时，新模型突破“大参数规模与低延迟交互难以兼顾”的瓶颈，在大规模架构基础上实现高效实时音视频交互：模型总参数达 5600 亿（激活参数 270 亿），却依托 LongCat-Flash 系列创新的 ScMoE 架

title_i18n.zh: LongCat-Flash-Omni正式发布并开源：开启全模态实时交互时代
title_i18n.en: LongCat-Flash-Omni Officially Released and Open-Sourced: Ushering in the Era of Full-Modal Real-Time Interaction
title_i18n.es: LongCat-Flash-Omni se lanza oficialmente y se hace de código abierto: inicia la era de la interacción multimodal en tiempo real.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 11月3日， LongCat-Flash系列再升级，全新家族成员LongCat-Flash-Omni正式发布并开源，LongCat官方App同步上线公测。目前，新App已支持联网搜索、语音通话等功能，视频通话等功能会稍后上线；Web端则增加图片、文件上传和语音通话等功能。 据介绍，LongCat-Flash-Omni以LongCat-Flash系列的高效架构设计为基础（Shortcut-Connected MoE，含零计算专家），集成了高效多模态感知模块与语音重建模块，在总参数 5600 亿（激活参数 270 亿）的庞大参数规模下，仍实现低延迟的实时音视频交互能力，为开发者的多模态应用场景提供了更高效的技术选择。 新模型也是业界首个实现“全模态覆盖、端到端架构、大参数量高效推理”于一体的开源大语言模型，首次在开源范畴内实现了对标闭源模型的全模态能力，并凭借创新的架构设计与工程优化，让大参数模型在多模态任务中能实现毫秒级响应，解决行业内推理延迟的痛点。 具体来看，LongCat-Flash-Omni在一体化框架中整合了离线多模态理解与实时音视频交互能力，并采用完全端到端的设计，以视觉与音频编码器作为多模态感知器，由 LLM 直接处理输入并生成文本与语音token，再通过轻量级音频解码器重建为自然语音波形，从而实现低延迟的实时交互。所有模块均基于高效流式推理设计，视觉编码器、音频编解码器均为轻量级组件，参数量均约为6亿，延续了 LongCat-Flash 系列的创新型高效架构设计，实现了性能与推理效率间的最优平衡。 ▲LongCat-Flash-Omni模型架构 与此同时，新模型突破“大参数规模与低延迟交互难以兼顾”的瓶颈，在大规模架构基础上实现高效实时音视频交互：模型总参数达 5600 亿（激活参数 270 亿），却依托 LongCat-Flash 系列创新的 ScMoE 架
excerpt_i18n.en:
On November 3, the LongCat-Flash series was upgraded with the official release and open-sourcing of its new family member, LongCat-Flash-Omni, while the LongCat official App simultaneously launched its public beta. The new App now supports features like online search and voice calls, with video calls to follow later; the web version has added capabilities such as image and file uploads and voice calls. 

LongCat-Flash-Omni builds on the efficient architecture of the LongCat-Flash series (Shortcut-Connected MoE, including zero-computation experts), integrating efficient multimodal perception and voice reconstruction modules. With a total of 560 billion parameters (27 billion activated), it achieves low-latency real-time audio-video interaction, offering developers a more efficient technical option for multimodal applications.

This new model is the industry's first open-source large language model to combine full-modal coverage, end-to-end architecture, and efficient inference with large parameters. It pioneers open-source capabilities matching closed-source models in full-modal tasks and, through innovative design and engineering optimizations, enables millisecond-level responses for large-parameter models in multimodal tasks, addressing the industry's challenge of inference latency.

Specifically, LongCat-Flash-Omni integrates offline multimodal understanding and real-time audio-video interaction within a unified framework, employing a fully end-to-end design for visual and audio processing.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 3 de noviembre, la serie LongCat-Flash se actualizó nuevamente con el lanzamiento y código abierto del nuevo miembro LongCat-Flash-Omni, mientras que la aplicación oficial de LongCat inició su prueba pública. Actualmente, la nueva app ya admite funciones como búsqueda en línea y llamadas de voz, con videollamadas próximamente; la versión web añadió carga de imágenes y archivos, y llamadas de voz. Según se informa, LongCat-Flash-Omni se basa en la arquitectura eficiente de la serie LongCat-Flash (Shortcut-Connected MoE, incluyendo expertos de cálculo cero) e integra capacidades multimodales.

title_i18n.en: Senators announce bill that would ban AI chatbot companions for minors
title_i18n.zh: 参议员提出法案，拟禁止未成年人使用人工智能聊天伴侣。
title_i18n.es: Senadores anuncian un proyecto de ley que prohibiría los asistentes de inteligencia artificial para menores.

excerpt_i18n.en: U.S. senators have introduced a bill to ban AI chatbot companions for minors, focusing on protecting children from potential mental health risks.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 美国参议员提出法案，旨在禁止未成年人使用AI聊天机器人伴侣。该法案针对可能对儿童心理健康产生负面影响的AI技术，以加强保护措施。

items.title: AWS and OpenAI announce multi-year strategic partnership
items.raw_excerpt: OpenAI and AWS have entered a multi-year, $38 billion partnership to scale advanced AI workloads. AWS will provide world-class infrastructure and compute capacity to power OpenAI’s next generation of models.

title_i18n.en: AWS and OpenAI announce multi-year strategic partnership
title_i18n.zh: AWS与OpenAI宣布达成多年战略合作
title_i18n.es: AWS y OpenAI anuncian una asociación estratégica plurianual.

excerpt_i18n.en: OpenAI and AWS have entered a multi-year, $38 billion partnership to scale advanced AI workloads. AWS will provide world-class infrastructure and compute capacity to power OpenAI’s next generation of models.
excerpt_i18n.zh: OpenAI与亚马逊云服务达成一项为期多年、价值380亿美元的合作协议，旨在扩展先进人工智能工作负载。亚马逊云服务将提供世界级基础设施和计算能力，以支持OpenAI新一代模型的运行。
excerpt_i18n.es: OpenAI y AWS han establecido una colaboración plurianual de 38.000 millones de dólares para escalar cargas de trabajo avanzadas de inteligencia artificial. AWS proporcionará infraestructura de primer nivel y capacidad de computación para impulsar la próxima generación de modelos de OpenAI.

items.title: Policy Maps: Tools for Guiding the Unbounded Space of LLM Behaviors
items.raw_excerpt: AI policy sets boundaries on acceptable behavior for AI models, but this is challenging in the context of large language models (LLMs): how do you ensure coverage over a vast behavior space? We introduce policy maps, an approach to AI policy design inspired by the practice of physical mapmaking. Instead of aiming for full coverage, policy maps aid effective navigation through intentional design choices about which aspects to capture and which to abstract away. items.title: LinEAS: End-to-end Learning of Activation Steering with a Distributional Loss
items.raw_excerpt: The growing use of generative models in daily life calls for efficient mechanisms to control their generation, to e.g., produce safe content or provide users with tools to explore style changes. Ideally, such mechanisms should require low volume of unpaired data (i.e., without explicit preference), and should be cheap, both at train and inference time, while preserving output quality.
